title: graph
description: `graph` creates an undirected graph compatibility object with inspectable `Nodes` and `Edges` tables. It supports edge-list construction with numeric or named nodes, optional edge weights, optional node names, and dense adjacency matrices.

signatures.label: G = graph(s, t)
signatures.description: Create an undirected graph from source and target node vectors.

signatures.label: G = graph(s, t, weights, names)
signatures.description: Create a weighted graph and assign node names.

signatures.label: G = graph(A)
signatures.description: Create a graph from a square dense adjacency matrix.

notes: Unnamed graph `Nodes` tables include an `Index` column because RunMat's current table representation cannot encode a nonzero-height table with zero variables.
Edge weights must be finite nonnegative values.
gpu_residency: No. Graph construction and traversal are host metadata/control-flow operations.
